Name: (BAGI) Better Artisan Goods Icons for Lunna Astray - Cometkins' Style
Author: Zyrnathos
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/505AIXP.png[/img]
[/center][center]
[/center]﻿Much to my surprise, no one has ever made a BAGI pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]'s awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray expansion[/url] even though it's been released (and constantly updated ever since) for years. It also doesn't help that I'm a die-hard fan of the equally magnificent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url], without which I'd rather quit the game.

As a (kinda) perfectionist that I am, it therefore comes down to either a) continue playing the mod with mismatched artisan goods, or b) remove Lunna - Astray from my mod folder. Since neither option would do, I settled on creating the pack myself with the artistic skill I barely possess.

The results aren't too satisfactory, but they'll have to do until someone else is similarly motivated.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6FNMsP3.png[/img]
[/center]
[color=#ffff00][b]**IMPORTANT**[/b][/color] This mod is but a BAGI content pack and [u]does nothing on its own[/u].
Please follow these steps to ensure smooth usage:
[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url].
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Extract all into your Stardew mod folder. By default, it should be [i]C:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
[*][color=#93c47d][Extra] [/color]Not actually required, but I highly recommend you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿ as well for a matching set of all artisan goods.

[*][color=#93c47d][Extra] [/color]Also not required, but you may want to additionally download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Beehouse[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13780]Fruit Tree Honey[/url] (choose one, NOT both!) along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Mead[/url] if you'd like to make honeys, and thus meads, from the trees as well.
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/aJWbekg.png[/img]﻿
[/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]CatCattyCat[/url] for her integral, to me, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38715215]Cometkins[/url]﻿ for the original sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]﻿﻿ for his exceptional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray expansion[/url]﻿; do check it out if you adore Krobus and his people!
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Includes both regular fruits & vegetables AND trees honeys & meads.
You can safely delete the latter if you don't intend to use, although it should be fine to leave as is.
